description: This PHP class defines the 'InterviewAttachment' entity used in the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It maps to the 'ohrm_job_interview_attachment' database table and includes properties for storing attachment details like filename, type, size, content, associated interview, and comments. The class also uses a decorator trait for extended functionality, and methods for accessing and mutating its properties are included.

classes.name: InterviewAttachment
classes.description: Entity class representing a file attachment associated with an interview, including metadata such as filename, content, type, size, comments, and linkage to the Interview entity.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the attachment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the attachment.

methods.name: getInterview
methods.description: Returns the Interview entity associated with this attachment.

methods.name: setInterview
methods.description: Associates an Interview entity with this attachment.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the file.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type of the file.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file in bytes.

methods.name: setFileSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the file, either as a resource or string.

methods.name: setFileContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the file.

methods.name: getAttachmentType
methods.description: Returns the type identifier of the attachment.

methods.name: setAttachmentType
methods.description: Sets the type identifier of the attachment.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns any comment associated with the attachment.
